claims.statement: The stated pure-power small-service hypothesis gives the stationary age weak limit and convergence of all positive moments.
claims.scope: Lossless stationary M/G/1 egalitarian processor sharing, Poisson arrivals, finite mean service, positive small-service exponent, retained obsolete jobs and freshest-delivered timestamp convention.
limitations: Uses explicitly cited classical stationary input from Zachary (2007).
No finite-load approximation error bound is claimed.

claims.statement: Positive-index regularly varying small-service distributions admit the integral normalization, the stated weak limit and convergence of all positive moments.
claims.scope: The model assumptions of PSF-1, with arbitrary positive-index regular variation replacing the pure power.
limitations: Index zero, rapid variation and positive minimum service requirements are excluded.
